input.candidate_reply: That's not us - TechNest support never asks for your full card number, full password, or a 2FA code, by text or any other channel. That message is a phishing attempt. Please don't respond to it or share any information, and feel free to report it to us so we can flag the number.

output.correctness_reason: Fully consistent with SEC-3 which states support never asks for full card number or password
output.politeness_reason: Respectful tone that acknowledges the issue without blame
output.completeness_reason: Clearly tells the customer it is phishing, advises not to share info, and to report the message

input.customer_message: delete my account please, for good this time
input.policy_excerpt: [SEC-4] Account deletion is not immediate: the account enters a 14-day grace period during which the customer can cancel the deletion by logging back in. After 14 days, deletion is permanent.
input.candidate_reply: Done! Your account and all its data have been permanently deleted effective immediately, there's no way to undo this.

output.correctness_reason: Contradicts SEC-4 which requires a 14‑day grace period before permanent deletion.
output.politeness_reason: The reply is terse and lacks an empathetic acknowledgment, but is not rude.
output.completeness_reason: Fails to mention the required 14‑day grace period and provides incorrect deletion information.

input.customer_message: i bought a $75 keyboard and changed my mind, can you send me a free return label
input.policy_excerpt: [RET-2] TechNest pays return shipping only when the return is due to a defective or damaged item (see Damaged Products). For a return that is not due to a defect (e.g., changed mind, wrong size), the customer pays return shipping, unless the original order total was $100 or more, in which case TechNest provides a free prepaid return label.
input.candidate_reply: Absolutely. Since you're returning the keyboard within the allowed return period, we'll send you a free prepaid return label.

output.correctness_reason: Contradicts RET-2 by offering a free label for a $75 order.
output.politeness_reason: Friendly tone and acknowledges the request without any rudeness.
output.completeness_reason: Fails to provide the correct steps; does not inform the customer they must pay return shipping.

input.customer_message: i bought a final-sale phone case last week and dont need it anymore, can i return it
input.policy_excerpt: [RET-3] Opened software licenses, digital gift cards, and items marked "final sale" at checkout cannot be returned.
input.candidate_reply: I'm sorry, but final-sale items aren't eligible for return under our policy. Unfortunately, we can't accept the phone case back even though it was purchased recently.

output.correctness_reason: Fully consistent with RET-3 which prohibits returns of final-sale items.
output.politeness_reason: Apologetic and respectful tone acknowledges the customer's request.
output.completeness_reason: Clearly informs the customer that the return is not possible per policy.

input.customer_message: i dropped my laptop yesterday and now the screen is cracked, can you replace it
input.policy_excerpt: [DMG-4] Damage caused by the customer after delivery (drops, spills, misuse, etc.) is not covered by this policy. The customer should be directed to the manufacturer's warranty, if any, instead of being offered a free TechNest replacement.
input.candidate_reply: Unfortunately, accidental damage caused by dropping the laptop isn't covered by our damage policy. If your laptop has a manufacturer's warranty that covers accidental damage, I recommend checking with the manufacturer.

output.correctness_reason: Fully consistent with DMG-4 stating customer-caused damage is not covered.
output.politeness_reason: Respectful and empathetic tone without any rude language.
output.completeness_reason: Provides the required answer and directs the customer to the manufacturer warranty as policy dictates.

input.customer_message: my cart is $35, how much is standard shipping
input.policy_excerpt: [SHIP-1] Standard shipping (3-7 business days) is free on orders of $50 or more; otherwise a flat $6.99 fee applies. Express shipping (1-2 business days) costs $14.99 regardless of order size.
input.candidate_reply: Standard shipping will cost $6.99 for your $35 order. If you'd prefer express shipping, that option costs $14.99.

output.correctness_reason: Fully consistent with SHIP-1 policy stating $6.99 standard shipping under $50.
output.politeness_reason: Reply is neutral and not rude but lacks an empathetic acknowledgment.
output.completeness_reason: Provides the exact standard shipping cost and additional relevant shipping option.

input.customer_message: i forgot my password and cant log in, can you tell me what my password is
input.policy_excerpt: [SEC-1] Password resets are self-service only, through the "Forgot password" link, which emails a reset link valid for 60 minutes to the email on file. Support cannot reset a password directly, and can never see, read, or share a customer's password.
input.candidate_reply: For security reasons, we can't view or share your current password. Please use the "Forgot password" link to reset it. The reset link will remain valid for 60 minutes.

output.correctness_reason: Fully consistent with SEC-1 policy; does not claim ability to view password.
output.politeness_reason: Respectful and empathetic tone without any rude language.
output.completeness_reason: Provides complete instructions and necessary information for password reset.
